title: One canonical key per vendor: accept the aliases people already have
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Accept the alternate env names vendors and tools use (GOOGLE_API_KEY, KIMI_API_KEY, HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN, ...) without the user renaming anything. Tests zc_key_aliases_*.
